use default

let factorial = n rec => if n <= 1 then 1 else n * rec(n - 1) fi

digits(n: int, base_value: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let remaining mut = n

    while remaining > 0 do
        yield remaining % base_value
        remaining = remaining / base_value
    od
si

digit_factorial_sum(n: int, base_value: int) -> int =>
    digits(n, base_value)
        |> map(factorial)
        |> reduce(0, (sum, f) => sum + f)

factorions(base_value: int) -> List[int] =>
    stream(1, n => n || n + 1)
        |> take(1499999)
        |> filter(n => digit_factorial_sum(n, base_value) == n)
        |> collect()

for base_value in [9, 10, 11, 12] do

        "base {base_value}: {found |> join(" ")} ({found.count} factorions)")
